The '''Honeymoon Palace''' was a building on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. It catered to [[Marriage/Legends|newly-wed]] couples on their honeymoon.<ref name="Modest" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Excuse me, gorgeous. I have some, uh, things to cancel. Honeymoon Palace on Naboo, for starters. We'll continue this later.|Doc|<ref name="Modest" />}}
The Honeymoon Palace was first mentioned in the conversation "A Modest Proposal" with [[Archiban Frodrick Kimble|Doc]], a companion character for the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. If [[Gender/Legends|female]] Knights refuse Doc's proposal of marriage, he informs them that he will have to cancel his reservation.<ref name="Modest" />
